subject: Re: Exchange runway and acceptance for evaluation artifacts
messages:
From: Katie Morgan <katie@retailnova.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: RetailNova Procurement <procurement@retailnova.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Exchange runway & MAP for eval artifacts

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the latency profiles and the cost controls looked promising for our pilot. Procurement asked me to pull together a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we can exchange a small set of testcases and a 25k-row promptpack for a 6-week evaluation.

High-level asks from our side:
- We need a limited-use license for the dataset and promptpack, restricted to the pilot engineers and not to be shared externally.
- A 6-week acceptance window with an agreed destruction/takedown date thereafter.
- Confirmation that Redwood will not retain copies for benchmarking outside the pilot (we can sign an addendum).

Can you send a draft MAP + a checklist of what Redwood needs to accept and ingest the artifacts (format, S3 presigned link, manifest, contact for SOC2 evidence)? Katie

[RetailNova internal note: procurement will expect a short runbook that maps deliverables to acceptance gates.]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Katie Morgan <katie@retailnova.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange runway & MAP for eval artifacts

Katie — thanks for the clear list. I attached a proposed MAP workbook and a sample manifest to speed the onboarding. Key points in our proposal (summary below) — full details in RetailNova_MAP_v2.xlsx.

Summary of Redwood proposal:
- Scope: 25k promptpack + sample testcase bundle (sandbox only). Ingest into an ephemeral sandbox under a mutually agreed lane.
- Usage cap: access restricted to 12 named engineers; models may be used only for evaluation and not for training or model tuning.
- Retention: data will be retained in the sandbox for 6 weeks; automatic snapshot and then a secure wipe on the takedown date.
- Auditability: we will provide activity logs (query-level) for the pilot period; audit export will be delivered to your procurement contact.
- Security: we will host in our US region for this pilot; KMS key managed by Redwood with audit trail.
- Exceptions: any request to export artifacts outside the sandbox requires explicit joint sign-off.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached MAP workbook and the manifest format (promptpack-sample_manifest.csv).
2) Procurement sends any redlines to me and CCs Ben (billing/terms) and Priyom (legal).
3) We lock dates and I’ll send a DocuSign envelope for the MAP + limited-use addendum + mutual takedown schedule.

Attachments: RetailNova_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook), promptpack-sample_manifest.csv (manifest template).

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
